title: Abhi Maza Aayega Na Bidu
blurb: Now the fun begins — the gleeful announcement that a situation has just become entertaining, almost always at somebody else's expense. It is the desi internet's equivalent of pulling up a chair and getting the popcorn out, and the delivery carries genuine anticipation rather than malice, which is what makes it land. Play it when drama ignites in the group chat, when a rematch is accepted, or when two people who dislike each other are seated at the same table. The anticipation is the celebration. Abhi maza aayega na bidu.
origin: The viral 'now it gets fun' line from Indian meme culture.
